text: Chapter 10: The Lost God's Ship@The Nightmare Returns
Head to Celarra Plateau with Anono, a mysterious creature\nthat becomes your new friend, to reunite with Reliza who has\nheaded there first with the others!
Defeat the monsters living in Celarra Plateau and find the\nWind Ark!
Evil spirits are attacking a human near the path to reach\nthe swamp at the bottom of the valley. The ark is there, so\nget rid of them and save that human!
